title: Cgroups, namespaces, and beyond: what are containers made from?
summary: Jérôme Petazzoni explains how Linux containers are built from kernel features like cgroups, namespaces and SELinux. He demonstrates putting the pieces together by hand to make a container and compares runtimes and approaches like jails and zones.
why: HN recommends it as a talk that makes containers click, showing that containerization is not virtualization and demystifying what Docker does.

quote.text: I watched this talk couple of years ago that made docker/containers finally click for me.
